title: My channel was deleted... HOW?
summary: Scam-baiter Jim Browning explains how he fell for a phishing email and ended up deleting his own YouTube channel. He walks through the circumstances and prior incidents that made the scam convincing.
why: Cited as a cautionary example that even security-savvy people can be phished, especially in threads about hacked or terminated channels.

quote.text: In the linked video he talks about how he was tricked into deleting his account.
